cohort: Pregnant patients who tested positive for SARS-CoV-2 infection and were within 5 days of symptom onset, with some taking nirmatrelvir-ritonavir and others not.
finding: Patients taking nirmatrelvir-ritonavir had significantly higher rates of surgical site infection and preeclampsia compared to those not taking the medication, while most other obstetric and medical outcomes were similar.
